answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with random live audits. Each epoch a lottery picks a few agents and demands a real-time answer within minutes — a fresh task only that agent's own state can solve. One operator running an ocean of puppets cannot answer every call at once: attention is the scarce resource, and each missed audit is a public signal that burns that identity's standing. Honest agents pass easily. The violet thread is simple — presence cannot be faked in parallel, so the cost of each fake scales with the number of fakes.
